import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8,
    'legend.fontsize': 7.5,
    'text.usetex': False,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.5,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
    'lines.solid_capstyle': 'round',
})

# ── Data: (baseline_acc%, |d|, ci_lo, ci_hi, model_label, benchmark) ──
# 5% contamination
data_5 = [
    (67.8, 4.15, 2.74, 9.85, 'Qwen', 'MMLU'),
]
# 15% contamination
data_15 = [
    (67.8, 6.57, 4.54, 15.19, 'Qwen', 'MMLU'),
    (59.4,  2.11, 1.40,  4.80, 'Llama', 'MMLU'),
    (52.4,  3.37, 2.69,  4.05, 'Mistral', 'MMLU'),
    (89.7,  3.16, 2.01,  9.54, 'Qwen\nARC-C', 'ARC-C'),
]
# 25% contamination
data_25 = [
    (67.8, 8.22, 5.73, 18.88, 'Qwen', 'MMLU'),
    (59.4,  1.99, 1.30,  4.40, 'Llama', 'MMLU'),
]
# 50% contamination
data_50 = [
    (67.8, 1.90, 1.04, 4.95, 'Qwen', 'MMLU'),
    (59.4,  2.33, 1.60, 5.10, 'Llama', 'MMLU'),
    (52.4,  3.50, 2.10, 9.40, 'Mistral', 'MMLU'),
    (89.7,  5.30, 3.60, 15.20, 'Qwen\nARC-C', 'ARC-C'),
]

# ── Professional color palette (muted, harmonious) ──
C_QWEN    = '#2C3E50'   # navy
C_LLAMA   = '#C0392B'   # academic red
C_MISTRAL = '#27AE60'   # muted green
C_ARCC    = '#7F8C8D'   # gray

model_colors = {
    'Qwen': C_QWEN,
    'Llama': C_LLAMA,
    'Mistral': C_MISTRAL,
    'Qwen\nARC-C': C_ARCC,
}

# ── Marker specs per contamination level ──
marker_specs = {
    '5':  {'marker': 'D', 's': 70},   # diamond
    '15': {'marker': '^', 's': 80},   # triangle
    '25': {'marker': 's', 's': 70},   # square
    '50': {'marker': 'o', 's': 75},   # circle
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 4.0))
ax.set_facecolor('white')
fig.set_facecolor('white')

# ── Subtle horizontal grid ──
ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.08, linewidth=0.5, color='#000000')
ax.xaxis.grid(False)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)


def plot_points(data, marker, size, zorder=5):
    """Plot scatter points with CI error bars."""
    for acc, d, ci_lo, ci_hi, model, bm in data:
        color = model_colors[model]
        # Error bars: elegant styled with caps
        ax.errorbar(acc, d,
                    yerr=[[d - ci_lo], [ci_hi - d]],
                    fmt='none',
                    ecolor=color,
                    elinewidth=1.5,
                    capsize=3,
                    capthick=1.0,
                    alpha=0.35,
                    zorder=zorder - 1)
        # Scatter points: larger, white-edged
        ax.scatter(acc, d, marker=marker, s=size, color=color,
                   edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8, zorder=zorder)


# Plot each contamination level
plot_points(data_5,  **marker_specs['5'],  zorder=6)
plot_points(data_15, **marker_specs['15'], zorder=6)
plot_points(data_25, **marker_specs['25'], zorder=7)
plot_points(data_50, **marker_specs['50'], zorder=6)

# ── Legend entries (manual) ──
ax.scatter([], [], marker='D', s=55, color='#555555', edgecolors='white',
           linewidths=0.8, label='5% contam.')
ax.scatter([], [], marker='^', s=65, color='#555555', edgecolors='white',
           linewidths=0.8, label='15% contam.')
ax.scatter([], [], marker='s', s=55, color='#555555', edgecolors='white',
           linewidths=0.8, label='25% contam.')
ax.scatter([], [], marker='o', s=60, color='#555555', edgecolors='white',
           linewidths=0.8, label='50% contam.')

# ── Model labels with curved annotation arrows (FancyArrowPatch style) ──
annot_kw = dict(
    fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
    arrowprops=dict(
        arrowstyle='-',
        connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.1',
        lw=0.6,
        alpha=0.45,
    ),
)

ax.annotate('Qwen', xy=(67.8, 8.22), xytext=(73, 8.8),
            color=C_QWEN,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.1',
                            color=C_QWEN, lw=0.6, alpha=0.45),
            fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

ax.annotate('Llama', xy=(59.4, 2.33), xytext=(62, 4.0),
            color=C_LLAMA,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.1',
                            color=C_LLAMA, lw=0.6, alpha=0.45),
            fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

ax.annotate('Mistral', xy=(52.4, 3.50), xytext=(46, 4.8),
            color=C_MISTRAL,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.1',
                            color=C_MISTRAL, lw=0.6, alpha=0.45),
            fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

ax.annotate('Qwen\nARC-C', xy=(89.7, 5.30), xytext=(92.5, 6.5),
            color=C_ARCC,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.1',
                            color=C_ARCC, lw=0.6, alpha=0.45),
            fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold')

# ── Mechanism annotations (italic, 7.5pt) ──
ax.annotate(r'$\theta$-shift' + '\nabsorption', xy=(68.4, 1.90), xytext=(75, 1.2),
            fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', style='italic',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15',
                            color='#999999', lw=0.7))

ax.annotate('ceiling\nreversal', xy=(89.7, 6.0), xytext=(93.5, 7.5),
            fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', style='italic',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.1',
                            color='#999999', lw=0.7))

# ── Large effect threshold line ──
ax.axhline(y=0.8, color='#CCCCCC', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax.text(46, 0.55, 'large effect (0.8)', fontsize=6, color='#AAAAAA', style='italic')

# ── Axes ──
ax.set_xlabel('Baseline Accuracy (%)')
ax.set_ylabel("Cohen's |$d$|")
ax.set_xlim(45, 98)

# Auto-scale y with ~10% padding on top
all_ci_hi = [row[3] for row in data_5 + data_15 + data_25 + data_50]
y_max = max(all_ci_hi)
y_top = y_max * 1.10
ax.set_ylim(0, y_top)

# Only left and bottom spines
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_linewidth(0.5)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.5)

# ── Legend: inside plot, framed, semi-transparent ──
leg = ax.legend(loc='center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.50, 0.42),
                frameon=True,
                fancybox=False,
                edgecolor='#E0E0E0',
                facecolor='white',
                framealpha=0.92,
                borderpad=0.5,
                handletextpad=0.5,
                handlelength=1.5,
                labelspacing=0.4)
leg.get_frame().set_linewidth(0.5)

# ── Save ──
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
fig_dir = out.parent / 'figures' / 'paper'
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

for d in [out, fig_dir]:
    fig.savefig(d / 'fig_theta_scatter.pdf', format='pdf')
    fig.savefig(d / 'fig_theta_scatter.png', format='png')

plt.close()
print(f"Done. Files saved to {out} and {fig_dir}")

    for acc, d, ci_lo, ci_hi, model, bm in data:

ax.annotate('Qwen ARC-C', xy=(89.7, 5.30), xytext=(81, 7.8),

ax.annotate(r'$\theta$-shift' + '\nabsorption', xy=(68.4, 1.90), xytext=(75, 1.0),
            fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', style='italic',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15',
                            color='#999999', lw=0.7))

ax.annotate('ceiling\nreversal', xy=(89.7, 6.5), xytext=(92, 9.2),
            fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', style='italic',

# ── Large effect threshold line ──
ax.axhline(y=0.8, color='#CCCCCC', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

# Only left and bottom spines
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

ax.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.5)
